🚀 RPSC SI/Platoon Commander 2025 Result 2026: Out for 1015 Posts!

  Working knowledge of Hindi written in Devnagari Script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture.

  Total Vacancy: 1015 Posts (A total of 1015 vacancies are available, including 896 for Sub Inspector (AP), 4 for Sub Inspector (AP) Sahariya, 25 for Sub Inspector (AP) Scheduled Area, 26 for Sub Inspector (IB), and 64 for Platoon Commander (RAC))

  Women Candidates – Minimum height: 152 cm, Weight: 47.5 kg (except Saharia category).
  SC/ST Candidates – Height & chest may be 5 cm less if suitable candidates are not available.
  Garhwali/Gurkha Candidates – Height: 160 cm, Chest: 79 cm deflated / 84 cm inflated




📝 RPSC SI/Platoon Commander 2025: Exam Pattern

  Written Exam:
    
      General Hindi – 2 hours, 200 marks
      General Knowledge & General Science – 2 hours, 200 marks
      (36% marks in each paper & 40% overall to qualify; SC/ST relaxation up to 5 marks)
    
  
  Physical Efficiency Test: 100 marks (min. 50% to qualify)
  Aptitude Test & Interview: 50 marks, assessing personality, behaviour, training, aptitude, leadership, and knowledge of Rajasthani culture
  Final Merit: Based on written exam, physical test, and interview marks

Note: The exam will be conducted in an objective format (Offline/Online). All questions will be multiple-choice type.



💰 Pay Scale & Selection Process

  Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Pay Level L-11 (Grade Pay Rs. 4200/-)
  Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam, PET & Interview. If required, the commission may apply scaling/moderation/normalization in evaluation. The merit list will be prepared based on the total marks obtained in the written exam and interview
